path: Acquire the Incubator Segment: Unda, Venus
lines: - Lotus: "So the Corpus have recovered an Incubator Segment? This is an excellent opportunity. Go to Elara and recover the Incubator Segment. Every Tenno deserves to have a Kubrow by their side."

- Ordis: "An Incubator Segment? You want to turn me into a petting zoo? Ordis is happy to assist the Operator restoring ship functionality."

path: Acquire the Incubator Segment: Unda, Venus
After getting the segment
lines: - Ordis: "Joy. An Incubator. The only segment Ordis is glad — those savages looted— I would be happy to help you install it."

path: Acquire the Incubator Segment: Unda, Venus
Idles
lines: - Ordis: "Ordis awaits Incubator Segment installation, Operator. No need to rush."

lines: - Lotus: "Good. Now you just need a Kubrow Egg to start the process. Feral Kubrow dens on Earth would be a good place to start looking."

lines: - Lotus: "You found a Kubrow Egg. Ordis will guide you through the hatching process. When complete, you will have to wait until the kubrow matures before you can take it on any missions."

- Ordis: "To think it's been ages since a Kubrow ⁠— spread filth all ⁠— graced this ship."

- Ordis: "Operator, drop the egg into the system to begin breeding— drop it on the floor."

lines: - Ordis: "Operator, are you ignoring the Incubator Segment? Good!"
